QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Rejected?!
QuestInfo.0: Her smile absolutely lights up the room! Savanna Faia definitely has the potential to be a star! Hand a Jackpot Entertainment business card to #rSavanna#k!
QuestInfo.1: ...She refused?! It seems like Savanna isn't some ordinary part-timer. She's an aspiring singer who's looking for a serious agency. However, she doesn't think Jackpot Entertainment could be her ticket to stardom. Maybe she'll change her tune if she hears #bBlake's new song#k...
QuestInfo.2: You played Blake's new song for Savanna and it seems like she had a change of heart. Ask her about auditioning again.

speech.0: Oh, you want a sample of my new song? Well, you're in luck! I have a recording I made on the keyboard. Now where did I put it?
speech.1: Ah, found it! Here you go! It stills needs a lot of work, but I hope you like it...
speech.2: It sounds like casting is going well. Don't let me get in your way! I trust your judgment. Good luck!

speech.0: Welcome to #rKerning Tower#k Cafe! Oh, you're back!

0.msg: #b(You hand a Jackpot Entertainment business card to Savanna Faia)#k\nI'm with Jackpot Entertainment, and we're looking for hot new talent! I think you might have what it takes to be a star. How about coming in for an audition?

1.msg: Jackpot Entertainment? I've heard of them, sure. But aren't they, well, old news? Becoming famous for my immense talent is my dream, of course. But I can't go hitching my star to an agency that can't guarantee me a successful debut.

2.msg: ...And an audition? Those aren't really my style. When I get discovered, I'm sure it'll be by someone who can see my natural potential right away.

3.msg: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can audition for Jackpot Entertainment. But I'm very grateful for all your help! Here, take this coupon for half off your next Bubble tea!

4.msg: #b(Savanna's mind seems made up, but perhaps she'd change it if she heard Blake's new song.)

0.msg: #b(Talk to Blake in the basement office and borrow a music sample.)

no.0: I'm sorry, I just don't think it's a good fit...

0.msg: #b(Talk to Blake in the basement office and borrow a music sample.)
